verdict.rationale: Floot lets you read and export the full TypeScript/React code and database to deploy elsewhere, which is a one-way exit rather than a local round-trip. Its remote MCP server can be added to Cursor, VS Code or Zed, but that only lets the editor's AI drive the hosted Floot project; it is not local editing synced back. Missing for 10: any documented way to push locally edited code back to the platform (git sync, CLI push, or import), a local dev/run workflow, and independent corroboration.
